config.geometry_label: Nominal portrait antenna-face coordinates; mounting and factory phase calibration unverified

limitations: Same-surface repeat test only. No evidence of recognizing a new window or wall.

Experimental comparison of glass-facing and drywall-facing radar readings. Distance, angle, window frame/coating, background and sensor placement can explain a prediction. Scores are not calibrated probabilities. Other materials can receive either label. This is not a validated glass detector.
Some surface distances were not recorded; distance can explain the class difference.
